A bought theme carries code for every feature it advertises, and you end up working around it. A custom theme contains only what your store uses, which keeps it fast and easy to change.

When the catalogue, content or markets go beyond what a theme handles comfortably. For most stores, a well-built Liquid theme is cheaper, faster to launch and easier to maintain.

Most will. We review each app first, keep the ones that earn their place and replace heavy script-based ones with theme code where it makes sense.

A hidden piece of code, account or scheduled task that lets an attacker back in after the visible malware is removed. It is the usual reason a hack keeps coming back.
